name: host-run
summary: Use when running a command or Bash script on a configured remote host
intents: ssh bash -c on a fish host

exit_codes.0: remote command exited 0; any other remote exit status is returned unchanged
exit_codes.1: --script failed bash -n locally (host not contacted), or the remote command exited 1
exit_codes.2: usage error: bad option, missing command or missing script file
exit_codes.3: setup failure: missing config, unknown host, missing dependency, or ssh exit 255 (connection failed)
exit_codes.124: --timeout expired; local ssh stopped, remote processes may still run
